subject: Emotions
title: Anger as Motivation
description: A quick win: understand Anger as Motivation.

hook.text: Michael Jordan was cut from his high school basketball team. He used that anger to fuel 25 years of dominance.

buildup.text: Anger activates approach motivation—the drive to move toward goals rather than retreat from threats.

discovery.text: Researchers found that angry people are more optimistic than scared people. Anger makes you feel you can change things.

twist.text: But anger-fueled motivation burns fast. It's rocket fuel—powerful but unsustainable for long-term goals.

climax.text: The best performers channel anger into a starting spark, then switch to discipline once momentum is built.

punchline.text: Anger starts the engine. It can't steer the car.

quiz.question: How does anger affect goal-oriented behavior?
